title: STU-1: Add server-side student paging, search and filters
body:
<!-- GEA-ROADMAP:STU-1 -->

## Goal
Make every authorized student reachable.

## Work
- Server-side pagination and search; filters for class, route and status; preserve list state; scope API queries by role.

## Done when
- All authorized students are reachable; filters are server-side; role boundaries are tested.

---
**Epic:** #75
**Roadmap:** GEA UI, privacy and security plan

title: STU-2: Build a phone-first student list
body:
<!-- GEA-ROADMAP:STU-2 -->

## Goal
Make student lookup easy on phones.

## Work
- Responsive student cards; show permitted name/class/roll/route fields; open details; use accessible touch targets.

## Done when
- Works at 360px and displays only role-authorized fields.

---
**Epic:** #75
**Roadmap:** GEA UI, privacy and security plan

title: STU-3: Add role-aware student detail tabs
body:
<!-- GEA-ROADMAP:STU-3 -->

## Goal
Provide permission-aware student details.

## Work
- Profile, Attendance, Marks, Fees and Transport tabs; hide unauthorized tabs; enforce access in APIs; add loading/empty/error states.

## Done when
- Teachers cannot access Fees; clerks cannot access Marks; API denial tests pass.

---
**Epic:** #75
**Roadmap:** GEA UI, privacy and security plan

title: STU-4: Improve student add and edit forms
body:
<!-- GEA-ROADMAP:STU-4 -->

## Goal
Reduce invalid student records.

## Work
- Group fields; use existing class/section/route records; validate approved phone format; show save and validation feedback; prevent silent overwrites.

## Done when
- Valid references only; clear validation; explicit edits; visible save result.

---
**Epic:** #75
**Roadmap:** GEA UI, privacy and security plan

title: STU-5: Add bulk class and section assignment
body:
<!-- GEA-ROADMAP:STU-5 -->

## Goal
Allow authorized staff to assign multiple students.

## Work
- List unassigned students; multi-select; preview; validate class/section; audit assignments.

## Done when
- Bulk assignment works for authorized roles and rejects invalid targets.

---
**Epic:** #75
**Roadmap:** GEA UI, privacy and security plan

title: STU-6: Replace student delete with left-school workflow
body:
<!-- GEA-ROADMAP:STU-6 -->

## Goal
Prevent accidental hard deletion.

## Work
- Replace ordinary Delete with Mark as left school; confirm; retain authorized history; reserve hard deletion for approved retention process.

## Done when
- UI cannot hard-delete; leaving action is confirmed and audited.

---
**Epic:** #75
**Roadmap:** GEA UI, privacy and security plan

title: STU-7: Mask sensitive student fields by default
body:
<!-- GEA-ROADMAP:STU-7 -->

## Goal
Reduce exposure of contact details.

## Work
- Mask phone numbers; reveal only for authorized roles; log reveal action without logging the value; avoid client logs.

## Done when
- Numbers masked by default; authorized reveal only; audit trail contains no phone value.

---
**Epic:** #75
**Roadmap:** GEA UI, privacy and security plan

title: DSH-1: Build role-specific dashboards
body:
<!-- GEA-ROADMAP:DSH-1 -->

## Goal
Show each role only relevant work.

## Work
- Admin summary; teacher assigned classes and pending tasks; clerk collection and overdue fees; real API values only; enforce API permissions.

## Done when
- Role dashboards show real authorized data; no demo numbers.

---
**Epic:** #76
**Roadmap:** GEA UI, privacy and security plan

title: DSH-2: Remove fabricated dashboard numbers and notifications
body:
<!-- GEA-ROADMAP:DSH-2 -->

## Goal
Make every count and badge truthful.

## Work
- Remove fixed unread badge and demo fallbacks; show empty states; distinguish request failure from zero.

## Done when
- No fabricated counts; API errors never appear as empty data.

---
**Epic:** #76
**Roadmap:** GEA UI, privacy and security plan

title: DSH-3: Add today's attendance status panel
body:
<!-- GEA-ROADMAP:DSH-3 -->

## Goal
Show which classes completed attendance today.

## Work
- Use actual attendance and school calendar; link to attendance; respect teacher assignments, holidays and weekends.

## Done when
- Teachers see assigned classes; admins see pending classes; values match records.

**Epic:** #76

title: DSH-4: Add accessible real-data dashboard charts
body:
<!-- GEA-ROADMAP:DSH-4 -->

## Goal
Present trends with accessible alternatives.

## Work
- Attendance and monthly collection charts from APIs; equivalent table; fee permissions; responsive light/dark themes.

Limit drivers to necessary route information.

## Work
- Show only assigned route; expose only approved rider fields; enforce backend route scoping; block access to other routes.

body:

Support safe route assignment and moves.

- Assign from student/route pages; validate route and stop; preview fee impact; update counts; audit changes.

title: TRN-5: Decide whether GEA should collect live bus location
body:
<!-- GEA-ROADMAP:TRN-5 -->

## Goal
Make a privacy and safety decision before tracking.

## Work
- Document need; if proposed define purpose, viewers, guardian notice, retention and access; do not collect before school approval.

## Done when
- Written decision exists; no tracking before approval; implementation is separately reviewed.

body:

Prevent loss of in-progress work.

## Work
- Define eligible drafts and protection; retry failed saves; show saved/pending/unsaved; prevent duplicate submits; minimize browser storage.

## Done when
- Network interruption is clear; retry does not duplicate; storage follows privacy design.

- Define tokens and reusable components; replace inline styles where practical; remove unused CSS only after dependency checks; coordinate CSP.
